cards.summary: Tell FAiRY what is going on: get advice now, and learn how to ask your own AI for help next time.
Tarot, but the deck is Rewind Era objects and experiences. Pull a card for a reading and advice—practical, with late-night-commercial drama.
Let the paper fortune teller pick a cocktail and a conversation starter for the table. Ghostbuster (spirit-free) options are available if you prefer.
Use Just Call to get fun advice from someone who would have written something way better than “Have a great summer!” (brutal) in your high school yearbook.
Truth: what have you copied from AI without checking? Dare: give AI a clearer brief using a made-up task. Your turn.
